description: Backend code quality hooks - ktlint, detekt, Flyway SQL validation for Kotlin Spring Boot

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.kt ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/backend" && ./gradlew detekt --auto-correct -q 2>&1 | head -30 || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == */db/migration/*.sql ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/backend" && ./gradlew flywayValidate -q 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi
hooks.description: 6. Flyway 검증 - migration SQL 파일 문법 체크
